knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The control hierarchy places engineering controls such as wet methods, extraction and isolation before personal protective equipment.
A fan moves dust around the room and does not capture it at its source, so it is not a dust control for honing.
Compressed air is named as a method that must not be used to clean surfaces or clothing, because it spreads the dust.
A failed water feed means the wet method has stopped. The cut stops, the method is restored and the dust control is checked before work continues.

practicalCriteria: Sets up the water feed or extraction at the point of cut before the first pass
Keeps the wet method running for the whole pass and at each grit change
Cleans up with approved methods only
Records the equipment and water checks
passRule: Knowledge checks: 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate and is not granted by the knowledge check: an assessor must observe every critical practical criterion and record it.
evidenceRequired: Equipment and extraction record with make, model and rating
Water flow check before start and at each grit change
stopWorkCriteria: Wet method or extraction not running
Area not isolated where other people are nearby
The only cleaning method available is dry or uses compressed air
